parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame forms the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses the shelves and doors, maintaining the cabinet’s shape and stability.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports all other components.

parts.name: Shelf 1
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal plywood shelf inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items and divides the cabinet space.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf 2
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides additional storage levels within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary or adjustable depending on design.

parts.name: Shelf 3
parts.Basic_description: A central shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet vertically for organized storage.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during use.

parts.name: Shelf 4
parts.Basic_description: A higher-level shelf made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items placed in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during use.

parts.name: Shelf 5
parts.Basic_description: The topmost shelf of the cabinet made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the uppermost storage surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or adjustable but not movable during use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 1
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of plywood with a handle.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the lower storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 2
parts.Basic_description: A paired lower cabinet door made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the lower section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 3
parts.Basic_description: A middle cabinet door made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the middle storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 4
parts.Basic_description: A paired middle cabinet door made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the middle section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 5
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It covers the upper storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door 6
parts.Basic_description: A paired upper cabinet door made of plywood.
parts.Functional_description: It encloses the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges to open and close.
